title: Verify a template that is both auto-apply at the location and a customer default is added only ONCE to a new work order
refs: S9 known gap (auto-apply + customer-default duplication); S7-R5,S9-R2
custom_preconds:
1. A template at the location is set to auto-apply.
  2. The same template is also set as a default for a customer.
custom_steps:
1. Create a new work order for that customer.
  2. Look at the work order's whole-work-order fees/discounts (the 'WO Fees & Discounts' card and the Financial Info count).
  3. Count how many times the shared template's fee/discount was added.
custom_expected:
1. The shared template's fee/discount appears exactly once on the new work order.
  2. No duplicate copy is added.
